_notes: Sensirion SGP40 VOC sensor at 0x59 (fixed). Detection: get_serial_number (0x3682, 1 ms) - three data words, each with a Sensirion CRC-8 (:crc8w). Init: start a raw measurement - measure_raw_signal (0x260F) with the default compensation 50 %RH (0x8000, CRC 0xA2) and 25 degC (0x6666, CRC 0x93); the result is ready after 30 ms. Poll (1 s, the rate Sensirion's VOC algorithm expects): read the previous measurement (SRAW_VOC word + its CRC, which isn't checked), then start the next, so no poll waits for the measurement. The value is the raw signal in ticks: the VOC index (0-500) needs Sensirion's gas index algorithm, run by the host (e.g. the app). Compensation stays at the defaults: the record can't feed in another sensor's humidity and temperature.

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-23): the lone 0x99 is NACKed (half a 16-bit command), so nothing is sent on; the serial number and the measurement are unchanged
